title: Qwen App Launches Paid Plans: Office Assistant Up to 128 Yuan/Month, AI Video Generation Charged Separately

content_html:
August 11th news: Alibaba's Qwen App launched a paid plan for professional users last night, including two models: office assistant subscription membership and individual AI video generation quotas, further exploring the commercialization path of AI applications.

Among them, the office assistant membership is divided into three tiers: flagship, elite, and advanced. The flagship package costs 128 yuan per month or 1,499 yuan per year, offering up to 20 times the quota; the elite package costs 49 yuan per month or 568 yuan per year, with a quota of 5 times; the advanced package costs 19 yuan per month or 200 yuan per year, with a quota of 2 times. Ordinary users who have not activated the membership can still continue to use the office assistant.

The AI video generation feature uses a separate quota purchase method, offering five limited-time special packages. The quota is valid for 3 months from the date of activation, with prices as follows: 10 quotas for 26 yuan, 50 quotas for 116 yuan, 100 quotas for 228 yuan, 200 quotas for 438 yuan, and 500 quotas for 968 yuan.

Previously, on August 7th, the Qwen App launched several new features, including the office assistant, on the PC version and integrated Alibaba's latest flagship model Qwen3.8-MAX, with related functions available free of charge to all users at that time. This further addition of paid quotas for professional users indicates that Qwen is gradually expanding from free basic functions to high-frequency, professional value-added services.

content_html_zh:
8月11日消息：阿里巴巴旗下Qwen App昨晚推出针对专业用户的付费计划，包括办公助手订阅会员和个人AI视频生成配额两种模式，进一步探索AI应用的商业化路径。

其中，办公室助理会员分为旗舰、精英、高级三个等级。 旗舰套餐每月128元，每年1499元，最高赠送20倍额度；精英套餐每月49元或每年568元，额度5次；高级套餐费用为每月19元或每年200元，额度2次。 未激活会员的普通用户仍可以继续使用办公助手。

AI视频生成功能采用单独配额购买方式，提供五种限时特价套餐。 额度自激活之日起3个月内有效，价格如下：10个额度26元、50个额度116元、100个额度228元、200个额度438元、500个额度968元。

此前，8月7日，Qwen App在PC版上推出了办公助手等多项新功能，并集成了阿里巴巴最新旗舰机型Qwen3.8-MAX，相关功能届时向所有用户免费开放。 此次专业用户付费额度的进一步增加，标志着Qwen正逐步从免费的基础功能向高频次、专业化的增值服务拓展。
